violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: observed turkey sausage (49F, 47F, 44F, 45F) in #3
violations.corrective_action: The CFM discarded the food items during the inspection for compliance.

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: TPHC, Food Marked with 4 Hour End Point
violations.observation: The following food item(s) for which time rather than temperature is used as a control is not marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control: the hot-held food items such as hash browns, sausage patties and egg patties, held in the hot holding shelving unit are on using time with timers, but the timers were not set.
violations.corrective_action: The CFM set the timers for the appropriate time frame for discard, during the inspection for compliance.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: the 4 drawer prep top cooler registered at 46F.
violations.corrective_action: The CFM will need to obtain repairs for the 4 door prep top cooler and provide proof of repairs to the EHS for a follow up. Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Manual Wash Water Temperature
violations.observation: The temperature of the in-use wash water solution was observed at less than 110F. The hot water at the 3 vat sink registered at 108F at the highest.
violations.corrective_action: The CFM will need to obtain repairs for the hot water at the 3 vat sink, and provide proof of the repairs to the EHS for a follow up within 10 days.
